tagline: Essential Utilities, Inc. is a regulated utility company providing water, wastewater, and natural gas services to approximately 5.5 million people across nine states.
hero_kpi_rationale: Consolidated operating revenues are the primary indicator of company size and growth in the regulated utilities sector, reflecting the combined performance of water and natural gas segments.

kpis.name: Consolidated Operating Revenues
kpis.explanation: Total amount of revenues generated by the company's regulated and non-regulated activities.
kpis.description: Revenues increased 18.6% in 2025 compared to 2024, primarily driven by growth in regulated water and natural gas segments.
kpis.signal: Strong revenue growth driven by regulated segments.

kpis.name: Net Income
kpis.explanation: Total company profit after deduction of all expenses, including taxes.
kpis.description: Net income increased 3.5% in 2025 compared to 2024, reflecting overall business growth.

kpis.name: Capital Expenditures
kpis.explanation: Amount invested in the acquisition or improvement of the company's physical assets.
kpis.description: CAPEX increased 7.6% in 2025 compared to 2024, supporting network growth and maintenance.
kpis.signal: Sustained investments for infrastructure expansion and improvement.

kpis.name: Operations and Maintenance Expense
kpis.explanation: Direct costs associated with operating and maintaining utility infrastructure.
kpis.description: Operations and maintenance expense increased 8.9% in 2025, primarily due to increased employee and utility costs.
kpis.signal: Rising OPEX reflecting inflation and expansion.

kpis.short: Ratio of capital expenditures to depreciation expense
kpis.name: Ratio of Capital Expenditures to Depreciation Expense
kpis.explanation: Indicates whether the company is reinvesting sufficiently to maintain or extend its assets.
kpis.description: The 3.5x ratio in 2025 suggests the company is reinvesting more than depreciation, supporting asset maintenance and expansion.

kpis.name: Regulated Water Segment Revenues
kpis.explanation: Revenues generated by regulated water supply and wastewater treatment activities.
kpis.description: The regulated water segment saw revenues increase 8.6% in 2025, representing a significant portion of total revenues.

kpis.name: Regulated Natural Gas Segment Revenues
kpis.explanation: Revenues generated by regulated natural gas distribution.
kpis.description: The regulated natural gas segment experienced strong revenue growth of 32.6% in 2025, primarily driven by increased gas prices and higher consumption from colder weather conditions.
kpis.signal: Strong gas segment growth tied to pricing and consumption.

kpis.name: Total Assets
kpis.description: Total assets extracted from yfinance over the past four years.
kpis.signal: Total assets of €19.46 billion in the latest year

kpis.name: Merger with American Water
kpis.explanation: Merger agreement signed with American Water Works Company, Inc. on October 26, 2025.
kpis.description: Essential Utilities signed a merger agreement with American Water on October 26, 2025. Essential shareholders will receive 0.305 American Water shares for each Essential share held. Merger closing is expected for the end of Q1 2027, subject to regulatory approvals.
kpis.signal: Major strategic transaction redefining the company's landscape.

risks.title: Litigation
